description: Land Title Settlement Department - Madapathala, Four Gravets Galle D/S Division, Galle District - Cad. Map No. 810036 (22/14/2300029)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding land parcels in Galle District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their numbers, extents, ownership details (Galle Municipal Council), and nature of title. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" including "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes). There is no government personnel or structural changes, legal frameworks, commercial matters, or other specialized categories that would take precedence over the land classification.
